body.text: The Cover Fossil revives into Tirtouga, which evolves into Carracosta at level 37.

sections.heading: Playthrough Notes
body: Bulky physical attacker and possible setup sweeper.

body.text: Carracosta combines strong 133 Defense and decent 108 Attack. Shell Smash can turn it into a dangerous sweeper, while Sturdy or Solid Rock can help it survive difficult battles.
Use it as a sturdy physical attacker, or set up when a safe turn is available and attempt to sweep.

body: A strong, dependable choice that trades Archeops's raw speed for durability.

body.text: Strengths: High Defense and good physical Attack. Useful Water/Rock coverage. Shell Smash can dramatically improve its offense and Speed. Helpful defensive abilities.
Weaknesses: Four-times weakness to Grass. Slow before setup. Special Defense is less reliable.

sections.heading: Choice Context

body.text: Choose the Cover Fossil for a sturdy setup attacker. Choose the Plume Fossil for immediate speed and offensive power.

body: Archeops is strongest above half HP because of Defeatist.
Plume Fossil is usually easier for a normal playthrough.
